title: Ares

synopsis: After more than 200 years, the kingdom Chronos is declining. Ten years of peace undermined the army and in the country, formerly called the "Land of the Sword", is left with nothing but old heroes. In the south and east, two major kingdoms threaten Chronos. Silonika Isiris in the west is, too, gaining momentum with the smaller states, united under the Radinka Alliance. In addition, King Chronos apparently begins to lose his mind... In these challenging times Chronos's only hope lies in their mercenaries, among whom just came a new addition: the young, but incredibly skilled warrior Ares and his friends, Michael and Baron.

synopsis: One day, the Literature Club lends out its chairs to other clubs, leaving only a single chair behind. Each wants the other to take the seat, and neither is willing to back down out of kindness. In the end, Yuzu gets her way, and Shou is forced to sit in the chair alone. Shou feels bad about being the only one sitting... until a sudden idea strikes him. “If I’m sitting in the chair, then I can become the chair and let Senpai Yuzu sit on my lap, right?” Or so he thinks.

title: 8 Man
titleNative: 8マン
synopsis: Murdered by criminals, Detective Yokoda's body is retrieved by Professor Tani and taken to his laboratory. There, Tani performs an experiment that has failed seven times; Yokoda is the latest subject to have his life force transferred into an android body. For the first time, the experiment succeeds. Yokoda is reborn as the armor-skinned android 8 Man, able to dash at impossible speeds, as well as shape-shift into other people. He shifts himself into Yokoda, this time christening himself as "Hachiro Azuma". He keeps this identity a secret, known only to Tani and his police boss Chief Tanaka. Even his girlfriend Sachiko and friend Ichiro do not know he is an android. As 8-Man, Hachiro fights crime (even bringing his murderers to justice).
